steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Grammar accuracy is essential for the writing and speaking papers, where it is worth up to 40% of marks. Always check cases, word order and verb endings.

steps.title: German Exam Tips — Tenses: Future and Conditional
steps.body: 1. For Tenses: Future and Conditional, use a range of vocabulary and complex grammatical structures to access higher marks 2. Check verb tenses, agreements and word order carefully in your written work 3. In translation tasks, translate meaning rather than word-for-word 4. When writing about Tenses: Future and Conditional, include opinions and justifications, not just descriptions 5. For listening and reading, focus on key words and cognates to extract meaning

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in German about tenses: future and conditional. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on tenses: future and conditional. | Translate into German: "I think tenses: future and conditional is important because..."

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Four sentences using topic vocabulary with correct case endings, verb position and adjective endings. Include at least two different tenses for Higher tier. | A structured paragraph: Meiner Meinung nach... (in my opinion), ich finde... weil... (I think... because...), aber/allerdings... (however), zusammenfassend... (in summary). Use connecting words and va | "Ich finde, dass tenses: future and conditional wichtig ist, weil..." — ensure correct word order (verb at end after dass), correct case endings, and give a specific reason.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Use a range of tenses (present, past, future) to access higher marks Include opinions with reasons (ich finde... weil... / meiner Meinung nach...) Check case endings (nominative, accusative, dative) before finishing Get word order right: verb-second in main clauses, verb-at-end after dass/weil/wenn Use complex structures: subordinate clauses, modal verbs, separable verbs Include cultural references to German-speaking countries (DACH)
